delivery.native_motion: MiniMax H3, 24fps, length on 17k+5 grid, short edge 768 (768x1344)
delivery.duration_method: Generate the shortest legal H3 length that is at least the reference duration minus 0.10s. Trim the tail with ffmpeg to the reference duration. No speed ramp, no frame interpolation. Endings are holds so the trim is dead tail.
delivery.upscale: Only after shot QC pass. Target 2160x3840. Preserve texture and architectural edges. No oversharpen, no invented detail.

creative_direction.law: Everything stays physically real. The entire space becomes better designed.
creative_direction.message: Vesta can furnish, design, and refine the entire home. Detail transformations prove the intelligence behind the overall design.
creative_direction.room_requirement: Every room is fully resolved: seating or sleeping, tables, rugs, lighting, art, cabinetry, textiles, shelving, and a few accessories. Correctly scaled, architecturally appropriate, premium, intentional, realistic, spatially coherent. Not overcrowded.
creative_direction.transformation: Hard architectural cut, masked reveal, or a dissolve only where geometry aligns. No architecture morph.
creative_direction.motion: Restrained. A few inches of push or a locked cut. No orbit, no wobble, no exposure drift.

creative_format.within_detail: BEFORE is the first 30 percent of the detail shot and is immediately readable. A hard match cut. AFTER holds the remaining 70 percent.

transition.preferred: Very short matched transformation. Match cut.
forbid: moving furniture during the detail transition

creative_format.continuity: All six shots belong to the same room. Furniture, architecture, windows, flooring, lighting, and material palette stay spatially coherent.
creative_format.furnishing: Fully furnished and restrained: sofa or bed or bench, table, rug or textile, lighting, one or two art or decor objects, cabinetry where the room needs it. No clutter.
creative_format.astra_rule: Any MAJOR failure means the V2 post is not final.
creative_format.template_rule: Once POST_005 V2 passes Astra creative QC, its editing grammar is the production template for the other eleven posts.
